title: Let longing ask the sangat for the way
summary: The search through mind and body becomes hopeful when saintly company can point toward the Beloved.
takeaway: Let longing ask the sangat for the way home.
lifeApplication: When loneliness starts arguing that you must solve the ache alone, reach for one trusted voice in sangat and ask for the next faithful step.

source.shortMeaning: The seeker cannot find the Beloved by force; grace sends saintly company to show the way.
source.lifeApplication: Let loneliness become a request for guidance instead of a private room with no door.

evidence.coreClaim: The seeker cannot find the Beloved by force; grace sends saintly company to show the way.
evidence.turn: Longing becomes less trapped when it lets saintly company name the path toward the Beloved.
evidence.practicalImplication: When loneliness starts arguing that you must solve the ache alone, reach for one trusted voice in sangat and ask for the next faithful step.
